title: Present and past simple passive (Be + past participle) - Basic passive voice

options.answer: The letter was wrote by John.
The letter was written by John.
The letter is wrote by John.

explanation.en: The past simple passive is formed with 'was/were + past participle'. The past participle of 'write' is 'written', not 'wrote'.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее простое пассивное время образуется с помощью 'was/were + причастие прошедшего времени'. Причастие прошедшего времени от 'write' это 'written', а не 'wrote'.
explanation.uz: O'tgan zamon passiv nisbati 'was/were + o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi' bilan yasaladi. 'Write' so'zining o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi 'written', 'wrote' emas.

options.answer: The house is build every year.
The house is built every year.
The house are built every year.

explanation.en: The present simple passive uses 'is/are + past participle'. 'House' is singular, so we use 'is', and the past participle of 'build' is 'built'.
explanation.ru: Настоящее простое пассивное время использует 'is/are + причастие прошедшего времени'. 'House' единственное число, поэтому используем 'is', а причастие прошедшего времени от 'build' это 'built'.
explanation.uz: Hozirgi zamon passiv nisbati 'is/are + o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi' bilan ishlatiladi. 'House' birlik sonda, shuning uchun 'is' ishlatamiz, 'build' so'zining o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi 'built'.

options.answer: The windows was cleaned yesterday.

explanation.en: With plural subjects like 'windows', we use 'were' in past simple passive, not 'was' or 'is'.
explanation.ru: С подлежащими во множественном числе, как 'windows', мы используем 'were' в прошедшем простом пассивном времени, а не 'was' или 'is'.
explanation.uz: Ko'plik subjektlar bilan, masalan 'windows', biz o'tgan zamon passiv nisba-tida 'were' ishlatamiz, 'was' yoki 'is' emas.
